title: Repository cleanup and organization audit
description: Comprehensive review of geobeat repository structure, documentation, and organization. Remove unnecessary files, organize docs, apply best practices, make repo presentation-ready for external viewers

title: Audit root directory for clutter
description: Review root level files, identify unnecessary configs, old planning docs, temporary files. Move or delete as appropriate

title: Review and organize documentation structure
description: Audit docs/ directory, check for outdated/duplicate docs, ensure consistent formatting, create docs index if helpful

title: Clean up data-sources directory
description: Review data-sources structure, ensure armiarma submodule is properly configured, remove any cruft

title: Audit frontend structure and remove unused files
description: Review src/frontend/geobeat-ui for unused components, old configs, temp files, ensure clean structure

title: Update README.md for professional presentation
description: Review README, ensure it reflects current architecture, has clear setup instructions, looks professional for external viewers

title: Review .gitignore and ensure proper exclusions
description: Audit .gitignore for completeness, ensure all temp files, credentials, build artifacts properly excluded

title: Deploy frontend to Vercel with custom domain
description: Set up Vercel deployment: (1) Connect GitHub repo to Vercel project, (2) Configure build settings (root: src/frontend/geobeat-ui), (3) Set environment variables (NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://api.geobeat.xyz), (4) Add custom domain app.geobeat.xyz, (5) Enable automatic deployments from main branch, (6) Test preview deployments on PR branches, (7) Verify SSL certificate provisioned. Cost: Free tier initially.

title: Design and implement blog layout in Next.js
description: Create blog functionality in Next.js app: (1) Add /blog route structure, (2) Implement MDX support for markdown blog posts, (3) Create blog post layout component with typography, (4) Add blog index page listing posts, (5) Style with Tailwind matching existing design system. Reference: app/page.tsx for design patterns.

title: Security audit: check for exposed secrets and vulnerabilities
description: Security review before launch: (1) Scan codebase for hardcoded secrets (use git-secrets or trufflehog), (2) Verify .env files are gitignored, (3) Check API has CORS properly configured, (4) Test rate limiting works (simulate 100+ req/min), (5) Verify HTTPS enforcement on both domains, (6) Run npm audit and pip-audit for dependency vulnerabilities, (7) Check UFW firewall rules on server. Reference: docs/BEST_PRACTICES_RESEARCH_2025.md Phase 1

title: Configure DNS records for geobeat.xyz
description: Set up all DNS records at domain registrar: (1) app.geobeat.xyz CNAME to cname.vercel-dns.com, (2) api.geobeat.xyz A record to 37.27.88.255, (3) www.geobeat.xyz CNAME to app.geobeat.xyz, (4) Root @ domain CNAME to app.geobeat.xyz (or A record to Vercel IP), (5) Verify all records with dig/nslookup, (6) Document in DEPLOYMENT_CREDENTIALS.md. Reference: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md lines 105-132

title: Update README to match Astral style guide
description: Rewrite README with calm, technical tone: remove emojis, avoid hype, focus on utility, use active voice, demonstrate value through working code

title: Monitor first 24 hours: analytics, errors, user feedback
description: Post-launch monitoring plan: (1) Watch Vercel Analytics for traffic patterns, (2) Monitor API logs for errors (tail -f /var/log/geobeat-api.log), (3) Check Grafana dashboards every 4 hours, (4) Track social media engagement on announcement tweet, (5) Collect user feedback (Twitter replies, GitHub issues), (6) Document any bugs/issues for immediate hotfix, (7) Report metrics after 24h (unique visitors, API requests, error rate)

title: Create blog post assets (screenshots, diagrams, charts)
description: Generate visual assets for blog post: (1) Screenshot of dashboard showing Ethereum map, (2) Diagram explaining GDI components (PDI/JDI/IHI), (3) Chart comparing network scores, (4) Hero image for social sharing. Tools: Figma/Canva for diagrams, actual dashboard screenshots, export as PNG/WebP optimized.

title: End-to-end testing: full user journey from landing to dashboard
description: Comprehensive testing checklist: (1) Load app.geobeat.xyz, verify hero animation, (2) Click through all landing page sections, (3) Navigate to dashboard, verify network grid loads, (4) Click into Ethereum detail page, check map renders, (5) Test all breakpoints (mobile/tablet/desktop), (6) Verify API calls succeed (check Network tab), (7) Test blog post page, (8) Check footer links. Document any issues.

title: Move internal planning docs out of root
description: Move CLEANUP_PLAN.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, and other internal docs to appropriate locations. Keep root minimal and professional

title: Performance testing and monitoring setup
description: Establish performance baselines: (1) Run Lighthouse audit on all pages (target: 90+ performance), (2) Test API response times (target: <500ms for all endpoints), (3) Set up Vercel Analytics for frontend, (4) Configure Prometheus monitoring for API server, (5) Create Grafana dashboard for key metrics (request rate, latency, error rate), (6) Document performance benchmarks in docs/.

title: Optimize frontend performance (bundle size, images, fonts)
description: Performance optimization pass: (1) Run Next.js bundle analyzer, identify large dependencies, (2) Optimize images (WebP format, proper sizing, lazy loading), (3) Check font loading strategy (preload critical fonts), (4) Enable Vercel Analytics, (5) Measure Lighthouse score (target: 90+ performance). Run 'npm run build' and check output.

title: Write 'Introducing GEOBEAT' blog post
description: Write comprehensive blog post introducing GEOBEAT, explaining the problem (centralization risks), our solution (GDI metrics), and the technology. Target length: 1500-2000 words. Include: project vision, GDI formula breakdown, example network analysis, call-to-action. Reference: /docs/DEMO_IMPLEMENTATION.md for technical details.

title: Ruthless repository simplification for production readiness
description: Make this repo look like it was crafted by senior engineers, not vibe coded. Remove all cruft, consolidate directories, keep only what matters for production

title: Deploy Armiarma Network Crawler to Remote Server
Phase 1: Server Provisioning (Hetzner CPX41)
description: Provision Hetzner CPX41 server with Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, configure SSH authentication, disable password auth, create deployment user

title: Order Hetzner CPX41 server with SSH key
description: Create Hetzner account, order CPX41 server (Ubuntu 24.04 LTS), add SSH public key during setup

title: Verify SSH access to server
description: Test SSH connection using project key, verify root access, update SSH config with server IP

title: Disable password authentication
description: Edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config to disable password auth, restart sshd service

title: Create armiarma deployment user
description: Create non-root user 'armiarma' with sudo access, copy SSH key, verify sudo permissions

title: Review Hetzner server options and storage capacity
description: Verify CPX41 specs vs alternatives, confirm storage capacity (320GB if shared vs 240GB if CPX), document chosen configuration

title: Phase 2: Security Hardening (UFW, secrets, Docker)
description: Configure UFW firewall, generate database credentials, add resource limits to docker-compose, configure log rotation, install fail2ban

title: Phase 3: Application Deployment
description: Install Docker, create directory structure, copy armiarma files, create env files, build and start services, verify deployment

title: Phase 4: Systemd Service Setup
description: Create systemd service file, enable auto-start on boot, test service management and auto-restart

title: Phase 5: Backup & Data Persistence
description: Create daily backup script with pg_dump, configure cron job, test restoration process, optionally configure off-site backups

title: Phase 6: Monitoring & Alerting
description: Create Prometheus alert rules, configure notification channels, test alerts, document runbook procedures

title: Set up DNS and domain architecture
description: Configure geobeat.xyz DNS: api.geobeat.xyz for Hetzner API server, app.geobeat.xyz for Vercel frontend, set up SSL certificates

title: Review and polish dashboard UI for production
description: Audit entire dashboard UI for production readiness: (1) Test all map interactions (zoom, pan, tooltips), (2) Verify responsive design on mobile/tablet/desktop, (3) Check loading states and error handling, (4) Ensure demo notice is clear and prominent, (5) Test all navigation flows, (6) Verify accessibility (WCAG AA). File: src/frontend/geobeat-ui/app/dashboard/page.tsx

title: Create launch checklist and deployment runbook
description: Document deployment process: (1) Pre-launch checklist (DNS propagated, SSL valid, API healthy, etc.), (2) Deployment steps for frontend (Vercel trigger), (3) Deployment steps for API (Docker deploy, health check), (4) Rollback procedure if issues found, (5) Post-launch monitoring tasks (check Grafana, Vercel logs), (6) Incident response contacts. Save as docs/DEPLOYMENT_RUNBOOK.md

title: Implement API caching and rate limiting
description: Add production API features: (1) Implement Redis caching for GDI calculations (TTL: 1 hour), (2) Add rate limiting (100 req/min per IP using slowapi), (3) Add request logging (structured JSON logs), (4) Implement health check endpoint /api/health, (5) Add Prometheus metrics endpoint /metrics. Reference: docs/BEST_PRACTICES_RESEARCH_2025.md section on Python logging.

title: Draft announcement tweet thread
description: Write launch announcement for Twitter/X: (1) Thread structure: hook tweet + 4-5 follow-ups, (2) Hook: Why geographic decentralization matters (+ compelling stat), (3) Introduce GEOBEAT and GDI metric, (4) Share interesting finding from data (e.g., Ethereum US concentration), (5) Call-to-action: explore dashboard, (6) Include link to blog post and dashboard. Tone: technical but accessible.

title: Update README.md with live demo links
description: Revise README for public launch: (1) Add badges (build status, uptime), (2) Update 'Live Dashboard' link to https://app.geobeat.xyz, (3) Add link to blog post, (4) Refresh 'Current Status' section (Phase 1 complete, Phase 2 live), (5) Add 'Quick Start' section for contributors, (6) Include demo data disclaimer. Keep professional and concise.

title: Create social media assets (Twitter/X card, OG image)
description: Generate social sharing assets: (1) Design Twitter/X card (1200x628px) with GEOBEAT branding, (2) Create OpenGraph image showing dashboard preview, (3) Add metadata to Next.js layout.tsx (title, description, og:image), (4) Test sharing preview with Twitter Card Validator, (5) Store images in public/images/social/. Include project tagline and geobeat.xyz URL.

title: Set up SSL certificates for api.geobeat.xyz
description: Configure HTTPS for API domain: (1) Install certbot on Hetzner server, (2) Run certbot --nginx -d api.geobeat.xyz, (3) Verify certificate issued (check expiry date), (4) Configure auto-renewal cron job, (5) Test HTTPS endpoint (curl https://api.geobeat.xyz/api/health), (6) Update nginx config to redirect HTTP to HTTPS. Reference: docs/FRAMEWORK_DOCUMENTATION.md SSH hardening section

title: Build REST API backend for dashboard data
description: Create production API to serve GDI data: (1) Choose framework (FastAPI recommended for Python), (2) Implement /api/networks endpoint (list all networks), (3) Implement /api/networks/{id} endpoint (network detail + GDI scores), (4) Implement /api/networks/{id}/nodes endpoint (GeoJSON for map), (5) Add CORS configuration for app.geobeat.xyz, (6) Document endpoints with OpenAPI/Swagger. Deploy to api.geobeat.xyz

title: Add demo data disclaimer and methodology link
description: Add clear disclaimer to dashboard: (1) Prominent banner indicating demo data (Nov 2025), (2) Link to DEMO_IMPLEMENTATION.md explaining methodology, (3) Note about data freshness, (4) Call-to-action for live data inquiries. Place in dashboard header and network detail pages.

title: Deploy GEOBEAT Demo Dashboard and Blog to geobeat.xyz
description: Epic to deploy a complete demo experience at geobeat.xyz including: live dashboard with real network data, introducing blog post explaining the project, and all infrastructure needed to support public access. This includes domain setup, frontend deployment, API backend, and content creation.

title: Set up API server on Hetzner with Docker
description: Deploy API backend to Hetzner server: (1) Create Dockerfile for API app, (2) Add docker-compose.yml for API service, (3) Configure nginx reverse proxy for HTTPS, (4) Set up Let's Encrypt SSL certificate, (5) Configure UFW firewall rules (allow 443), (6) Test API endpoints from public internet, (7) Set up systemd service for auto-restart. Server: 37.27.88.255
